instructions_selected: - Simulator: **Questa Intel FPGA Edition 2024.3** (`questa_fe`, verified via `vsim -version`)
- Installed device family: **Agilex 7** (components: `quartus,questa_fe,agilex7`; the installer auto-added `agilex_common` and `quartus_part2`)
As with Questa under 26.1.1, `SALT_LICENSE_SERVER` is required by the Questa FPGA Edition license check.
command -v vsim && vsim -version                # expect: Questa Intel FPGA Edition-64 2024.3

A fresh login shell was verified after the switch: `quartus_sh --version` → 25.1.0 Build 129, `vsim -version` → Questa 2024.3, and `LM_LICENSE_FILE`/`MGLS_LICENSE_FILE`/`SALT_LICENSE_SERVER` all pointing at `~/quartus_25/LR-191011_License.dat`. Workflows expecting the 26.1.1 environment from Part B must now set it explicitly.
Same flow as Part B section 3 (`vlib work`, `vlog -sv ...`, `vsim -c work.tb -do 'run -all; quit -f'`). Launch from a terminal configured per A.1 so the license variables are inherited.
| Install via `qinst` (quartus, questa_fe, agilex7) | Completed successfully, 5 mins 2 secs |
The `QUARTUS_ROOTDIR_OVERRIDE` from `~/.bashrc` is active in your shell. Re-export the full A.1 block — setting `PATH` alone is not enough — or bypass the environment for a one-off check:

Same checks as Part B: `printenv LM_LICENSE_FILE MGLS_LICENSE_FILE SALT_LICENSE_SERVER` — all three must reference the `~/quartus_25/LR-191011_License.dat` file, not the old `IA-840f` one inherited from `~/.bashrc`.

**Important:** This Questa release requires `SALT_LICENSE_SERVER`. During verification, simulation failed with only `LM_LICENSE_FILE` and `MGLS_LICENSE_FILE`, then passed after setting `SALT_LICENSE_SERVER` to the license file.
Create `work` only if it does not already exist. For VHDL, compile sources using `vcom` instead of `vlog`.
